survey.title: Treatment Mix in Moderate-to-Severe Plaque Psoriasis: An Allocation Study

sourceAnchor.quote: Thinking about all of your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients, what percentage is currently managed primarily with each of the following approaches?

obligations.requirement: Q1. Thinking about all of your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients, what percentage is currently managed primarily with each of the following approaches?
expectedObservables: Question Q1 is displayed with text: "Thinking about all of your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients, what percentage is currently managed primarily with each of the following approaches?"
Answer input is of type allocation
Allocation row r1: "Topical therapy alone"
Allocation row r2: "Phototherapy"
Allocation row r3: "Oral systemic agents"
Allocation row r4: "Biologic therapy"
Allocation row r5: "Other approaches"

sourceAnchor.quote: You indicated that half or more of your patients receive an oral systemic or biologic therapy. Which factor has been most important in expanding your use of advanced therapies?

obligations.requirement: Q2. You indicated that half or more of your patients receive an oral systemic or biologic therapy. Which factor has been most important in expanding your use of advanced therapies?
expectedObservables: Question Q2 is displayed with text: "You indicated that half or more of your patients receive an oral systemic or biologic therapy. Which factor has been most important in expanding your use of advanced therapies?"
Answer input is of type radio
Option 1: "Stronger efficacy data"
Option 2: "Improved long-term safety evidence"
Option 3: "Better insurance coverage"
Option 4: "Patient demand"
Option 5: "Guideline changes"

sourceAnchor.quote: What is the single biggest barrier to moving more of your patients to advanced therapies?

obligations.requirement: Q3. What is the single biggest barrier to moving more of your patients to advanced therapies?
expectedObservables: Question Q3 is displayed with text: "What is the single biggest barrier to moving more of your patients to advanced therapies?"
Answer input is of type radio
Option 1: "Insurance / prior authorization requirements"
Option 2: "Out-of-pocket cost to patients"
Option 3: "Safety or monitoring concerns"
Option 4: "Patient preference for topical or non-drug approaches"
Option 5: "Other"
